ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.2.1 Lean Hybrid is a conservative refinement of JS1.1 Lean for RimWorld 1.5. It restores JS1.1's proven HasJobOnThing cache admission/store behavior and exact JS1 nearest-order key semantics, while retaining only three low-risk improvements validated during JS1.2 testing: typed Pawn/Thing/bool Harmony arguments instead of generic __args on the HasJobOnThing hot path, a last-bucket reference fast path for consecutive WorkGiver scans, and reuse of the light PackageContext/top-level bucket/order dictionaries. The JS1.2 low-reuse admission gate is removed because it reduced cache hit rate, and ThingBucket result dictionaries are no longer pooled or synchronously cleared because that moved millions of entry-clear operations onto the main-thread JobGiver path. ThingBucket result maps are again one-JobPackage objects and become GC-eligible at package end as in JS1.1. ShouldSkip and HasJobOnCell memoization remain removed, RegionHint remains retired, and ReachProfile authority, WorkPrefilter, haul accelerators, Path shadow policy, final GenClosest validation, Jobs and reservations remain unchanged and Vanilla/main-thread authoritative where applicable.
